description: All indices computed by finwire.pl, each under a stable id finwire_* (e.g. finwire_mortgage_barometer, finwire_credit_capacity_index, finwire_deposit_rate_index, finwire_savings_rate_index, finwire_rcn_price_index, finwire_price_gap_index, finwire_entry_threshold_index, finwire_credit_market_index, finwire_nowcast, finwire_legal_calendar): latest reading with its period, change vs the previous reading, method version and citation. Use get_finwire_index for one index with history.

group.description: Group: kredyt (credit), oszczednosci (savings), mieszkania (housing), rynek (market and forecasts), prawo (law).

status.description: live (default) = with a reading; planned = id reserved, in preparation.

name: list_finwire_indices
title: finwire index registry
